connections.addConnectionDialogDescription: Nothing moves until you finish setting one up.
connections.autoCreateOnReply: Add the organization and client when you reply to someone new
connections.emptyDescription: Right now every journey, client and note has to be typed in by hand. Connect a tool and the CRM starts filling itself in from the work your team already does.
connections.googleAutoCreateOnMeet: Add the organization and client when you meet someone new
connections.googleBringsIn: Emails, meetings and the people on them
connections.googleCatalogDescription: Bring in Gmail messages and Google Calendar meetings
connections.googleConnectDescription: Read-only Gmail and Calendar. Only conversations with organizations in the CRM are stored.
connections.googleDeleteSyncedDataDescription: Every email and meeting brought in from Google is removed from the CRM. The next check starts from now, so nothing deleted here comes back.
connections.googleEmailMismatch: That Google account has a different email address to the one you sign in with, so it cannot be attached to your account. Connect the Google account that matches your sign-in address.
connections.googleGenericConnectError: Google returned an error before the connection was made. Try again.
connections.googleNoRefreshToken: Google did not return a refresh token
connections.googleRevokeOptionalWarning: New email and meetings stop arriving. Everything already synced stays, and you can connect Google again from this page.
connections.googleStarterDescription: File email and meetings against the right organization
connections.googleSyncDescription: Meetings and email threads land on the matching organization as they happen.
connections.googleUnavailableDescription: Set GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET in the root .env file and restart.
connections.intakeCatalogDescription: The intake API is not available yet
connections.intakeDescription: This connection is not available yet. No endpoint, API key, or intake activity has been created for this workspace.
connections.microsoftBringsIn: Outlook email and the people on it
connections.microsoftCatalogDescription: Bring in Outlook email and the people on it
connections.microsoftConnectDescription: Read-only Outlook mail. Only conversations with organizations in the CRM are stored.
connections.microsoftDeleteSyncedDataDescription: Every email brought in from Outlook is removed from the CRM. The next check starts from now, so nothing deleted here comes back.
connections.microsoftEmailMismatch: That Microsoft account has a different email address to the one you sign in with, so it cannot be attached to your account. Connect the Microsoft account that matches your sign-in address.
connections.microsoftGenericConnectError: Microsoft returned an error before the connection was made. Try again.
connections.microsoftNoAutoRevokeNotice: Microsoft has no way for us to withdraw the consent itself — remove this app from your Microsoft account to do that.
connections.microsoftNoRefreshToken: Microsoft did not return a refresh token
connections.microsoftRevokeOptionalWarning: New email stops arriving. Everything already synced stays, and you can connect Microsoft again from this page.
connections.microsoftStarterDescription: File Outlook email against the right organization
connections.microsoftSyncDescription: Email threads land on the matching organization as they happen.
connections.microsoftUnavailableDescription: Set MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID and MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET in the root .env file and restart.
connections.pageDescription: Where your CRM gets its information, and what it is allowed to send on your behalf.
connections.revokeRequiredWarning: You will be signed out, and you cannot use the CRM again until you grant access.
connections.slackAgentsUsingHint: Built in chat, not here. Open one to change it.
connections.slackAlreadyInThereToast: Comp AI is already in there.
connections.slackApproveNotice: You approve the workspace in Slack. You can disconnect it here at any time.
connections.slackAskInsideToast: Ask someone inside to invite Comp AI.
connections.slackAskSomeoneTitle: Ask someone to add Comp AI
connections.slackBringsIn: Workspace members and channels the app has joined
connections.slackCapabilityDescription: Let deployed agents notify approved channels and people
connections.slackChannelListStaleNotice: Comp AI is not reading Slack right now. The list can be out of date.
connections.slackConnectErrorAccessDenied: Slack installation was cancelled before access was granted.
connections.slackConnectErrorAlreadyLinked: That Slack installer is already linked to another CRM account.
connections.slackConnectErrorEmailMismatch: The Slack installer's email must match the CRM account you are signed in with.
connections.slackConnectErrorUserInfoMissing: Slack did not return the installer's profile. Confirm the app has users:read and users:read.email, reinstall it, then try again.
connections.slackConnectErrorVerificationFailed: Slack rejected the app credentials or redirect URL. Check the client ID, client secret, and OAuth redirect URL, then try again.
connections.slackConnectingIntro: Connecting Slack gives the CRM a way in and a way out. What it actually does with that is up to you afterwards, one automation at a time.
connections.slackCopyFailedToast: Copying failed. Copy the command above by hand.
connections.slackDisconnectConfirmDescription: Agents stop sending to Slack immediately, and the cached channel list is cleared so a new app re-reads it. Who is matched to which Slack account is kept, so reconnecting the same workspace does not ask you to match everyone again.
connections.slackGrantedMemberNotice: Here is what Slack gave us. Only an owner or an admin can disconnect it.
connections.slackGrantedOwnerNotice: Here is what Slack gave us. Agents only post where their automation says.
connections.slackMatchRefreshHint: Refresh after a Slack email changes. The CRM matches exact email addresses only. Someone with no exact match stays unmatched, and an agent stops instead of guessing at a similar name.
connections.slackMissingPermissionsTitle: {count, plural, one {Slack held back # permission} other {Slack held back # permissions}}
connections.slackMissingPrivateChannelsTitle: Comp AI cannot reach private channels
connections.slackNeverPostElsewhere: Post anywhere except the destination approved in that automation
connections.slackNeverReadDm: Read a direct message between two people
connections.slackNeverSend: Send anything at all until you build an automation and switch it on
connections.slackNoAgentsYet: No deployed agents use Slack yet.
connections.slackNoChannelsYet: No channels yet. Comp AI reads the list from Slack after it connects.
connections.slackNoPeopleReviewed: No workspace people have been reviewed yet.
connections.slackNoTeammatesToMatch: No CRM teammates are available to match.
connections.slackPeopleMatchIntro: Match your CRM people to Slack once. Agents use these exact accounts later instead of guessing from a similar name.
connections.slackPrivateJoinDescription: It is a private channel, so Comp AI joins as you. Same as typing the invite yourself. Everyone in the channel sees it join. It reads nothing until you turn a permission on.
connections.slackPrivateNeedsHumanDescription: We cannot add Comp AI to a private channel yet. Someone already in #{channel} has to run this.
connections.slackReadingChannelListEllipsis: Reading the channel list from Slack…
connections.slackReadingChannelListToast: Reading the channel list from Slack.
connections.slackReconnectNotice: Reconnect to ask again. You lose nothing.
connections.slackScopeGroupsHint: Broad means the whole workspace, not one channel. Open a group to see the details.
connections.slackScopeHeldBack: Slack held this one back, so it is off.
connections.slackSends: Messages to approved channels and people
connections.slackSuggestionDealCreatedDescription: Post the journey to an approved channel.
connections.slackSuggestionDealReopenedDescription: Notify one approved channel or teammate.
connections.slackSuggestionDealWonDescription: Tell an approved channel about the enrollment.
connections.slackSuggestionsHint: Suggestions, not settings. None of them exist until you pick one and switch it on.
connections.slackSuggestionsTitle: Afterwards, most teams start with one of these

currencies.allConvertible: Every journey with an amount can be converted into the reporting currency.
currencies.exchangeRatesDescription: How many {currency} one unit of each currency buys. Fetched daily from open.er-api.com; a rate you enter here wins.
currencies.noDealsWithAmount: No journeys have an amount yet.
currencies.noRatesYet: No rates yet. Refresh to fetch them, or enter one by hand.
currencies.pageDescription: What your numbers are reported in, and how the other currencies get there.
currencies.rateInvalid: A rate has to be a number greater than zero.
currencies.reportingCurrencyChangeNotice: Changing this re-converts every journey at today's rates. Figures already reported will move.
currencies.reportingCurrencyChanged: Every total is now reported in {currency}.
currencies.reportingCurrencyDescription: Every total, chart and average in the CRM is expressed in this currency. Each journey keeps its own currency.
currencies.reportingCurrencyReadonlyNotice: Only an owner or an admin can change how money is reported.
currencies.unconvertedNotice: {count, plural, one {# journey cannot be converted, so it is left out of every total.} other {# journeys cannot be converted, so they are left out of every total.}}

general.agentModelDescription: The model the agent thinks with, routed through the Vercel AI Gateway.
general.agentModelSaved: The agent will use this model from its next session.
general.agentModelUnavailable: Could not reach the AI Gateway to list models. The agent is still running {model}.
general.languageDescription: The language the CRM shows you.
general.pageDescription: Who you are, and the model the research agent thinks with.
general.researchKeyDescription: Enter your Context API key so our agents can research every organization in the CRM.
general.researchKeySignUpPrompt: Don't have a Context API key? <link>Sign up here</link>
general.workspaceDescription: The name and website of the organization using this CRM.
general.workspaceNameDescription: Shown wherever the CRM refers to your own organization.
general.workspaceReadonlyNotice: Only an owner or an admin can change this.

members.pageDescription: Everyone who has access to your CRM.

sso.copyUnavailable: Could not copy the {label}. Select it instead.
sso.empty: No identity provider yet — everyone signs in with Google.
sso.nameDescription: Names the sign-in button. Cannot be changed later.
sso.pageDescription: Let your people sign in through your own identity provider. While one is configured, the sign-in page offers it instead of Google.
sso.redirectUriDescription: Add this at your provider before saving.
sso.removeProviderDescription: Nobody can sign in through it again. If this is the only provider, the sign-in page goes back to Google.
sso.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, domain or issuer…

tracking.addViaGtm: Add it through Google Tag Manager
tracking.allowedDomainsDescription: The script records page views on these hosts only.
tracking.allowedDomainsEmpty: Add the domain your website runs on to get your tracking script.
tracking.cookieLifetimeDescription: After this a returning visitor counts as somebody new. Shorten it if your policy asks you to.
tracking.cookieSubdomainsHint: Set the cookie on the exact host that served the page, never on the parent domain
tracking.cookiesDescription: How a returning visitor is recognised.
tracking.crossDomainHint: Carry the visitor between the domains below, so one journey is not counted as two people
tracking.gtmDataSiteAttributeNotice: Tag Manager drops a data-site attribute when it injects a script, so this form carries the site ID in the URL instead.
tracking.gtmStep1: In Tag Manager, add a new Custom HTML tag.
tracking.gtmStep2: Paste this snippet — not the one above — as the tag's HTML.
tracking.gtmStep3Prefix: Trigger it on All Pages, then publish the container. Keep
tracking.gtmStep3Suffix: off any consent-blocked category you do not need.
tracking.honourDntHint: Record nothing at all when the browser asks not to be tracked
tracking.limitToDomainsHint: On any other domain the script loads and then does nothing
tracking.limitToDomainsLabel: Limit tracking to the domains below
tracking.pageDescription: Track website visitors and automatically add clients when a form is submitted.
tracking.pageToCheckDescription: The page has to be public. A page behind a login always fails this check.
tracking.pageViewDespiteMissingSiteId: A page view did arrive in the last five minutes, so something on this site is still recording.
tracking.pageViewNotYet: No page view has arrived yet — open the page in a browser to send one.
tracking.pageViewRecent: A page view arrived in the last five minutes.
tracking.pauseTrackingHint: The script keeps loading and records nothing. Your domains and settings are kept
tracking.rotateSiteIdDescription: Every copy of the old script stops recording at once, including any you have forgotten about. You will need to paste the new tag on every page that carries the old one. Nothing already collected is lost.
tracking.rotateStopsAllCopies: · Rotating it stops every copy of the old script at once.
tracking.rulesDescription: Where the script may run, and how it follows a visitor.
tracking.scriptCardDescription: One tag, 4 KB, in the head of every page you measure.
tracking.scriptCopyUnavailable: Could not copy the script. Select it instead.
tracking.scriptFoundDescription: It answered in {ms} ms. Site ID {siteId} matched, and this domain is {allowed, select, yes {on} other {not on}} the allow list.
tracking.scriptMissingContainersSuffix: We also read Tag Manager container {containers}, and the tag is not in there either.
tracking.scriptMissingDescription: The page answered in {ms} ms, but the tag was not in the HTML. Check that it sits in the head, above anything that rewrites the page.
tracking.secureCookiesHint: Send the cookie over HTTPS and drop it on plain HTTP
tracking.siteIdRotated: Site ID rotated. Paste the new tag on your website.
tracking.tagManagerDropsSiteIdDescription: Container {containerId} carries the tag, but the site ID is not in the script URL. Tag Manager keeps only the URL when it injects a script, so a data-site attribute never reaches the page and the tracker never starts. Copy the Tag Manager snippet above and replace the tag's HTML.
tracking.tagManagerDropsSiteIdTitle: Tag Manager will drop the site ID
tracking.tagManagerFiresLaterNotice: The tag is not in the HTML, so it only runs once Tag Manager fires it — a page view is the proof.
tracking.trackingPaused: Tracking paused. The script stops recording within five minutes.
tracking.trafficSourcesDescription: Where your visitors come from. Only people who have submitted a form are attributed to a record.
tracking.trafficSourcesEmpty: No sources yet. They appear once the script records its first page view.
tracking.unreachableNotice: We only follow public pages, and we never follow a redirect to a private address.
tracking.verifyDescription: We load one page and look for the script, then read your Tag Manager container if it is not in the HTML.
